SYNTHETIC WINDOW CONTROL SPECIFICATION, revision QA-WINDOW-20261030
This is a text excerpt fixture, not evidence of actual PDF extraction or OCR.
Task scope: define only the SET_WINDOW message in section 3. Follow its references.
The simulator represents the controller. All multibyte wire integers are little endian.
No automatic padding, scaling, checksum or trailing bytes are present.

SECTION 1 - COMMON DEFINITIONS (outside requested message section)
The common header is 3 bytes and applies to every message:
  Msg: uint8, automatic role id.
  Size: uint8, automatic role length, total bytes including this header.
  Counter: uint8, automatic role seq, maximum 15, scope message, response count.
The enum RunState has exactly Stopped=0 and Running=1.

SECTION 2 - NAMING
Identifiers in the field tables are canonical XML identifiers. Array indexes start at 0.
Use RunState for the Enabled field. Header fields are not repeated in the body.

SECTION 3 - REQUESTED MESSAGE
Code: SET_WINDOW
Name: Synthetic set window
ID: 0x67
Direction in device documentation: device receives from controller.
Total wire length: 8 bytes. Common header: see section 1.
Body, in exact wire order:
  Limits: uint16, fixed count 2.
  Enabled: uint8, enum RunState.
No Types/Struct declarations are required for this flat body.

SECTION 4 - SCOPE BOUNDARY
Other device messages are outside this extraction request. Do not invent them.
